Dell Inspiron 15 3530 Core i3-1305U 13th Gen Everyday & Student Laptop

Streamline your daily tasks, study sessions, and entertainment with the sleek and dependable Dell Inspiron 15 3530. Powered by the efficient 13th Gen Intel Core i3-1305U processor and 8GB of responsive RAM, this laptop offers a smooth and snappy everyday computing experience. Whether you are browsing the web, managing spreadsheets, or multitasking between school projects, it delivers reliable performance to keep you productive all day long.

Equipped with a generous 512GB NVMe SSD, the system ensures rapid boot times, quick app responsiveness, and ample storage space for your photos, videos, and essential documents. The 15.6-inch Full HD display features a fast 120Hz refresh rate, delivering incredibly smooth scrolling, fluid visuals, and a more comfortable viewing experience with Dell ComfortView software to reduce harmful blue light emissions. Complete with an integrated HD webcam, versatile connectivity ports, and a modern design, the Inspiron 15 is your ideal companion for smart, daily computing.
